prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet is now active on your desktop! Test sound effects and quick controls below.", "Test Companion Sound"]
1: ["Name Your Companion", "Choose a unique name for your pet before finalizing their adoption certificate.", "Pet Name", "Confirm Name"]
2: ["What Kind of Companion Do You Want?", "Select a personality archetype to filter the best path for you.", "Playful & Energetic", "Calm & Focused"]
3: ["Safeguard Your Companion", "Signing in links your pet's personality and progress to your account so you never lose them.", "Cloud Pet Recovery Enabled", "Continue to Sign In"]
4: ["Your Pet is Waking Up...", "Listen to Companion Sounds", "Your pet will interact with your cursor and desktop windows once ready."]
5: ["For best results, upload high-resolution photos with clear lighting.", "Recommended: Well-lit front shot"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "Look for your companion on your desktop or in the system tray to control, show, or hide them.", "If your pet disappears, click the system tray icon to bring them back to the front."]
7: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pet", "Your account links your custom companion to cloud storage so your pet is always preserved.", "Automatic Cloud Save", "Sign In Securely"]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Create or choose an interactive virtual pet that lives right on your desktop while you work.", "Choose Your Pet Path"]
9: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "Generation Progress"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photos of user)
